body.id: Ilmuwan bertanya, mengamati, lalu menguji jawabannya dengan percobaan.
body.en: Scientists ask questions, observe, then test their answers with experiments.

body.id: Marie Curie meneliti sinar yang tak terlihat. Ibn al-Haytham meneliti cahaya.
body.en: Marie Curie studied invisible rays. Ibn al-Haytham studied light.

body.id: Keduanya mencatat semua percobaan dengan teliti.
body.en: Both wrote down every experiment carefully.

body.en: The Wright brothers built a powered plane that could fly and be steered.

title.en: Marie Curie and the new elements

ST-CURIE.source: Britannica Kids, "Marie Curie" (born 7 November 1867, Warsaw; women not allowed at the University of Warsaw; Paris and the Sorbonne in 1891; degrees in physics and mathematics; polonium, named for Poland, and radium, 1898; Nobel Prizes in Physics 1903 and Chemistry 1911, first woman laureate; died 1934 of a blood disease caused by radiation).

caption.id: Marie Curie lahir di Warsawa, Polandia, tahun 1867. Saat itu, perempuan tidak boleh kuliah di universitas di Warsawa.
caption.en: Marie Curie was born in Warsaw, Poland, in 1867. At that time, women were not allowed to study at the university in Warsaw.

caption.id: Tahun 1891, ia pindah ke Paris, Prancis, untuk kuliah. Ia belajar fisika dan matematika dengan tekun.
caption.en: In 1891 she moved to Paris, France, to study. She worked hard at physics and mathematics.

caption.id: Bersama suaminya, Pierre Curie, ia meneliti batuan yang memancarkan sinar tak terlihat. Tahun 1898, mereka menemukan dua unsur baru: polonium dan radium.
caption.en: With her husband, Pierre Curie, she studied rocks that gave off invisible rays. In 1898 they discovered two new elements: polonium and radium.

caption.id: Polonium ia namai dari nama negerinya, Polandia. Marie adalah perempuan pertama yang meraih Hadiah Nobel, dan ia meraihnya dua kali!
caption.en: She named polonium after her homeland, Poland. Marie was the first woman to win a Nobel Prize, and she won it twice!

caption.id: Kini kita tahu radium berbahaya, jadi ilmuwan bekerja dengan pelindung. Dari Marie Curie, kita belajar tekun, teliti, dan berani bertanya.
caption.en: Today we know radium is dangerous, so scientists work with protection. From Marie Curie we learn to be patient, careful and full of questions.

title.en: Ibn al-Haytham and the secret of light

ST-IBN-HAYTHAM.source: Wikipedia, "Ibn al-Haytham" (born c. 965 Basra, died c. 1040 Cairo; Book of Optics, written 1011-1021; showed that light from objects enters the eye; first clear description of the camera obscura, not its invention; emphasis on experiment; UNESCO International Year of Light 2015); UNESCO / 1001 Inventions, "1001 Inventions and the World of Ibn Al-Haytham" (2015).

caption.id: Ibn al-Haytham lahir di Basra, Irak, sekitar tahun 965. Kemudian ia lama tinggal di Kairo, Mesir.
caption.en: Ibn al-Haytham was born in Basra, Iraq, around 965. Later he lived for many years in Cairo, Egypt.

caption.id: Dulu banyak orang mengira mata kita memancarkan sinar supaya bisa melihat. Ibn al-Haytham ingin menguji apakah itu benar.
caption.en: Long ago, many people thought our eyes sent out rays so that we could see. Ibn al-Haytham wanted to test whether that was true.

caption.id: Ia membuat percobaan di ruang gelap yang berlubang kecil. Cahaya masuk lewat lubang itu dan membentuk gambar terbalik di dinding.
caption.en: He experimented in a dark room with a small hole. Light came in through the hole and made an upside-down picture on the wall.

caption.id: Ia menunjukkan bahwa kita melihat karena cahaya dari benda masuk ke mata. Semua percobaannya ia tulis dalam Kitab Optik.
caption.en: He showed that we see because light from objects enters our eyes. He wrote all his experiments in his Book of Optics.

caption.id: Kacamata dan kamera memakai ilmu cahaya yang ia pelajari. Dari Ibn al-Haytham, kita belajar menguji sebuah gagasan sebelum memercayainya.
caption.en: Glasses and cameras use the science of light that he studied. From Ibn al-Haytham we learn to test an idea before we believe it.

title.en: The Wright brothers learn to fly

ST-WRIGHT.source: National Park Service, "Wright Brothers" (toy helicopter 1878; bicycles from 1892; 17 December 1903 at Kill Devil Hills near Kitty Hawk: Orville, 12 seconds, about 120 feet; Wilbur's fourth flight 59 seconds, 852 feet); National Park Service, "The Road to the First Flight" (birds and wing warping, kite, wind tunnel 1901); Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum, 1903 Wright Flyer.

caption.id: Wilbur dan Orville Wright adalah kakak-adik dari Amerika Serikat. Waktu kecil, mereka membuat tiruan mainan helikopter dari ayah mereka.
caption.en: Wilbur and Orville Wright were brothers from the United States. As boys, they built copies of a toy helicopter their father gave them.

caption.id: Tahun 1892, mereka membuka toko sepeda di kota Dayton. Mereka pandai memperbaiki dan membuat sepeda.
caption.en: In 1892 they opened a bicycle shop in the town of Dayton. They were good at repairing and building bicycles.

caption.id: Mereka mengamati burung terbang, lalu menguji sayap dengan layang-layang dan terowongan angin. Mereka mencoba lagi dan lagi.
caption.en: They watched birds fly, then tested wings with kites and a wind tunnel. They tried again and again.

caption.id: Pada 17 Desember 1903, di dekat Kitty Hawk, Orville terbang 12 detik dengan pesawat bermesin. Itulah penerbangan pesawat bermesin pertama yang berhasil.
caption.en: On 17 December 1903, near Kitty Hawk, Orville flew a plane with an engine for 12 seconds. It was the first successful powered aeroplane flight.

caption.id: Hari itu, Wilbur juga terbang selama 59 detik. Berkat kerja sama dan ketekunan mereka, kini pesawat terbang ke seluruh dunia.
caption.en: That day Wilbur also flew, for 59 seconds. Thanks to their teamwork and patience, planes now fly all over the world.

title.id: Louis Braille dan huruf titik timbul
title.en: Louis Braille and the raised-dot letters

ST-BRAILLE.source: National Geographic, "How Louis Braille revolutionized a writing system—despite efforts to stop him" (born 1809, Coupvray; hurt at three in his father's leather workshop, blind by five; at ten at the Royal Institute for Blind Youth in Paris; heavy raised-letter books; six-dot cells at about 15, 1824-1825, book 1829; teacher at 19); United Nations, World Braille Day 4 January (proclaimed 2018, first 2019).

caption.id: Louis Braille lahir di desa Coupvray, Prancis, tahun 1809. Ayahnya membuat pelana dan tali kulit untuk kuda.
caption.en: Louis Braille was born in the village of Coupvray, France, in 1809. His father made saddles and harnesses for horses.

caption.id: Saat berumur 3 tahun, mata Louis terluka karena kecelakaan di bengkel ayahnya. Sejak umur 5 tahun, ia tidak bisa melihat.
caption.en: When he was 3, Louis hurt his eye in an accident in his father's workshop. From the age of 5, he could not see.

caption.id: Umur 10 tahun, ia bersekolah di sekolah anak tunanetra di Paris. Bukunya berhuruf timbul yang besar, berat, dan sulit diraba.
caption.en: At 10, he went to a school for blind children in Paris. Its books had big raised letters that were heavy and hard to read by touch.

caption.id: Sekitar umur 15 tahun, Louis membuat huruf dari enam titik timbul. Huruf titik itu mudah diraba, dan orang tunanetra bisa menulisnya sendiri.
caption.en: At about 15, Louis made letters out of six raised dots. These dot letters are easy to feel, and blind people can write them too.

caption.id: Kini huruf Braille dipakai di seluruh dunia, dan hari lahirnya, 4 Januari, menjadi Hari Braille Sedunia. Kita belajar bahwa semua orang berhak membaca.
caption.en: Today braille is used all over the world, and his birthday, 4 January, is World Braille Day. We learn that everyone has the right to read.
